definition: Lay out plugin.json and component folders and zip them into an uploadable plugin package.
outcome: a plugin archive with a valid plugin.json and its component folders exists as a file, ready to upload or publish; it is not installed anywhere

records.outcome: a plugin zip holding plugin.json and the skill folders under skills/ exists as a file, ready to upload
steps: Create .claude-plugin/plugin.json with name and version, plus a description
Place each skill folder under skills/
Add one folder per skill if the plugin carries several
Zip the plugin contents, or the wrapping plugin folder itself

evidence.anchor: ## Building and deploying your own skills
evidence.quote: The smallest valid package is the manifest plus your skill folder under `skills/`

records.notes: Zipping the plugin folder itself also works, since the upload accepts the single wrapping folder.

records.outcome: Claude has arranged the skill files into the plugin layout and produced the zip
preconditions: Cowork tasks available in your deployment
steps: Paste in the full rules from Plugin archive formats
Ask Claude to arrange the files and produce the zip

evidence.anchor: ## Building and deploying your own skills
evidence.quote: Claude can do the assembly in a Cowork task: give it the layout above, paste in the full rules from

records.notes: mode: cowork; Claude Desktop in Claude for Government does not include a packaging skill, so the layout must be in the request.
